maintenance_led.reason: Licenses stock photos, video and editorial content via subscriptions and packs; not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are media companies, brands, agencies and businesses buying image licenses, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by licensing its content library and subscriptions; merger with Shutterstock is one large deal, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Stock and editorial imagery can be bought from competitors like Shutterstock; switching is relatively easy, though editorial archive is distinctive.

notes: Editorial archive is somewhat unique, making the switching judgment borderline.
